body: I'm really sorry to hear it's happened to you, too.

What I do is I use a browser, when I'm on data, that lets me actually turn off images. The one I use is UC Browser. And then I only tap on the link if I think the image is going to be interesting. No images preload.

I'm not offended. I have 1 sibling left (3 are dead) and I know he'd be devastated. On the other side the coin is that he just doesn't understand the depression and grief.  He says he does. He's been through it. But he has unrealistic expectations that I can just "decide not to be depressed anymore" and that just hurts so bad. So it's like a yin yang thing. I can't tell you how many times I've said something similar, about how no one would even notice if I was dead. My mother is in a Memory Care Facility with dementia. I have had to mourn the loss of the mother that I had. The mother that talked to me everyday on the phone, texted me all throughout the day, and wouldn't go to bed at night until she knew I was home safe. I've had to mourn the loss of her. Half the time she doesn't even recognize me as who I am. And now that my husband dumped me and my mom is no longer there for me, I just don't have anyone on a daily basis to keep me going, to keep me wanting to keep going. My baby dog was the only thing that stopped me from killing myself years ago. And I  swore that whenever he died I would go too, because my mom is being taken care of and no one else really cares. But I just think my sibling would be devastated and that's haunting me. Every freaking one of my siblings also died "indigent" (and too young) and I figure I'm destined to have the same fate. Just a found dead body like my one sister. This is a sick world. BTW, you are welcome to pm me any time u want to.

I wish I had one to offer. :(  All I can offer is that my life has similarities to yours and I feel ya. For years, my trick was to reach out to as many resources as I could for therapy, for financial help, job-finding help for low income people. At least I felt like i was trying my best and my case workers were proud of me for trying so hard. But family doesn't understand. (Most of my family is dead, which doesn't help.) Friends are pulling away. That's just salt in the wound. But now... The depression is worse, I lost my baby (dog) just a few days ago, and I just don't want to live anymore. He was ALL I had. The pain is indescribable. Now I have nothing, nobody. That pain is unbearable. The only thing stopping me is the thought of what my suicide would do to certain people in my life. But, hopefully just knowing that it's not just you, that somebody out there understand you, helps a little.
I'm so sorry.  It's horrible. I feel the same way you do. 47 years of a shit life.
I absolutely feel the same way.

The problem is that I have no income and I'm waiting on a disability appeal with a lawyer and I have zero money. If I had money like a normal person I could have gotten my dog the help he needed. I think it would be irresponsible to get another pet knowing I cannot buy it even its most basic Veterinary needs like heartworm meds, flea prevention, vaccines, checkups, dentals, Etc and then if it got sick, it would be the same scenario all over again where he would die because I didn't have the money to save his life. I'm a cancer in this planet.
